bluf: Eskimoz is a French search acquisition agency founded in 2010, claiming 250+ consultants, five countries and 1,000+ clients, with offices listed from Paris to Düsseldorf, Milan, Madrid and London. It sells Global Search, meaning visibility on Google, TikTok, ChatGPT, Amazon and Reddit, led by SEO and GEO with proprietary tools including LLM Ranking. Its record shows undated moves from agency to European group and into Reddit as an acquisition channel. The Horus read is Favored (+25), best placed for KJ1. A rival should know it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt on its own site, and all 19 recorded clients are names only, five of them on other tracked books.
doing:
The positioning line, a Global Search acquisition agency turning digital marketing into revenue and making brands visible wherever buyers search (Google, TikTok, ChatGPT, Amazon, Reddit), decodes as: an SEO agency that has widened search to every surface where a buyer types a query. The headline claim, voted best European search agency for 2026 with 250 experts, five countries and 1,000+ clients, is a claim the record does not audit; the about page adds 10 languages and 10 proprietary tools.

The sold mix runs 12 lines, SEO and GEO first. Two lead lines score 3: AI Search / GEO (GEO service and LLM Ranking tool in the nav; 17 AI search URLs) and SEO (H1: Global Search acquisition agency). Three core lines score 2: AI Automation / Agents (an AI First heading, the tools Scribe and Search Agent), Content & Digital PR (Content Factory, Relations Presse, Netlinking) and Paid Search (SEA and GEA in the nav, a ChatGPT Ads agency page); everything else scores 1 or 0 with no evidence note. Proprietary tools listed: Eskimoz App, LLM Ranking, Brand Protector, Crawlr, Monitoring, Scribe, Search Agent and Reddit+.

AI posture in plain terms: search across Google and LLMs as one product, sold as GEO audits, the LLM Ranking tool, a ChatGPT Ads offer and AI content production, backed by published GEO barometers and a podcast. Moves: a 2026 award as best European search agency (homepage); undated, offices beyond France in Düsseldorf, Milan, Madrid and London, framed as a move from agency to European group; undated, Reddit launched as its own acquisition channel per a LinkedIn ad, r/Eskimoz past 500 members. Pricing signals: part of its fee is tied to the performance it generates (about page); its Google ads promote a quick online SEO audit tool. Conspicuously absent: no news, jobs or case study text in the deep record, no owned audience or CRM line, no named partners, and no ownership disclosure.
clients:
Eskimoz serves a mixed book in tourism, health, luxury, SaaS software, ecommerce, banking and insurance, automotive, energy and fashion, from France, with offices listed in Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille, Düsseldorf, Milan, Madrid and London.

The record holds 19 clients and 0 with an observed need: 18 come from a references page as case study entries with no described work and 1, ghd, is a homepage testimonial. The names are Ledger, Air Liquide, ALL Accor, Samsung, Randstad, École de Condé, Trainsweateat, Wethenew, Swile, Studapart, Speedy, PwC, Promovacances, Petit Bateau, Mailinblack, Homunity, Hindbag, Bouygues Immobilier and ghd. No case study title, slug or press release attaches a need to any of them, so every need is inferred from what the agency leads with, organic demand and AI visibility (SEO and GEO), with paid search and content behind; the record computes no need mix for this book.

Shared clients are the only observed texture: Samsung also sits on the books of moburst and transmission, Air Liquide and PwC on junto, ALL Accor on artefact, and Randstad on found. Five of the 19 names already buy from other tracked agencies.

What the base needs next: the Horus read ties it to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) as tailwinds and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two) as the headwind. It is likely, low confidence given a book with no described work, that the large brand names next buy AI visibility measurement across Google and LLMs, the product the LLM Ranking tool and the GEO barometers are built to sell; the record gives no client level evidence either way.
house: Say and do: 2 of 3 tested lines are practised on its own house. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 17 AI topic URLs in its sitemap. Paid Search is corroborated: it runs its own Google ads, 41 in the Transparency Center and 19 in the last 30 days, last shown 2026-09-25; a sample reads 'Réalisez votre Audit SEO en Ligne - Eskimoz | Auditez vite votre site en moins de 3 minutes'. Publishing cadence is read as corroborated on 2 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 3 in 365, against 389 URLs listed. No AI crawlers are blocked. Tag stack gtm and hubspot; CMS WordPress; no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack. LinkedIn: active, 7 ads, 2 company page and 5 thought leader ads by staff; a sample reads 'Stay visible and drive revenue - however your buyers are searching.' Meta and TikTok: no record.
market:
The Horus read gives a tailwind index of 25.2, band Favored, verdict Favored (+25). Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.322), driven by AI Search / GEO (+2) and Content & Digital PR (+1) against SEO (-1), and KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out, net 0.231). Most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two, net -0.071), driven by Paid Social (-1) and Programmatic & CTV (-1). Best scenario fit: The Bazaar of Agents (42/100). Moves: making P1 and P5, partial on P4, P6 and P8, absent on P2 and P7; P3 does not apply.

The Monsoon read gives index 54.9, band Breeze, inferred. Displacement 56.4 edges migration 53.4: the book is slightly more price sensitive than the hours are movable. SEO (14) and AI Search / GEO (7) carry the most movable hours; no hub office is listed, so the footprint is inferred, with a shore split of 45% Africa and the Maghreb, 30% South and Southeast Asia and 20% Eastern Europe.
openings: It is very likely (high confidence) that the llms.txt contradiction is the one to lead with: it sells GEO, an LLM Ranking tool and GEO barometers, yet its own site publishes no llms.txt, and the read marks P2 absent, so feeds, schema and entity work sit unclaimed beside its lead line. The falsifier is an llms.txt appearing on eskimoz.fr at the next compile. It is very likely (high confidence) that the book is contestable on evidence: 19 of 19 names carry no described work, so the question for Ledger, Petit Bateau or Bouygues Immobilier is what Eskimoz delivered, and Samsung (moburst, transmission), Air Liquide and PwC (junto), ALL Accor (artefact) and Randstad (found) already buy elsewhere. It is likely (moderate confidence) that the paid lines are the softer target: the KJ5 exposure runs through Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV, both scored 1 with no evidence, and P4 shows no first party data, creative volume or measurement depth. It is unlikely that price undercuts it, since part of its fee is already tied to performance; the sharper pitch is measured AI visibility with holdouts, which P8 partial says it does not yet show.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures (late October 2026): growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO lead line, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind.

I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility (late October 2026): US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth would test the Reddit acquisition channel it says it launched.
I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures (October 2026): output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would crowd the performance linked fee it already sells under KJ6.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend (rolling): the next $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM set the economics of its ChatGPT Ads offer under KJ2.
Follow up the undated office expansion and the 2026 best European search agency award for dates, and check whether eskimoz.fr publishes an llms.txt, which would close the contradiction.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as that date.
